visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white rabbit-ear headband and a strapless white floral-textured top, stands against a plain white wall. She looks directly into the camera, touching her chin thoughtfully and blinking. The lighting is soft, flat, and indoor. (2) The scene cuts to the woman changed into a black corset-style top with a small silver tiara. She stands in front of a wall illuminated by a red light from the side, creating a high-contrast cinematic effect. She poses with her hands near her face. (3) While in the black corset outfit, she holds up various game character illustrations in her hands. She gestures dynamically with her palms to emphasize the quality of the designs. The background remains the indoor setting with red and white lighting. (4) Screen recordings of a mobile game interface appear. It shows a character customization screen titled 'Paper Doll System'. Menus for outfits and hair are visible, and a color wheel is used to interactively change the character's clothing color. (5) The woman returns to the screen in the black top, gesturing with her fingers crossed and then showing two fingers. She explains the game's consumer-friendly features with an energetic and smiley facial expression. (6) An official promotional poster for a 'Fashion Design Contest' overlaying the screen. The woman points to the graphics and explains the voting rewards. She concludes the video by forming a heart shape with her hands towards the viewer.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a soft, melodic hum from a female voice. A bright, mid-tempo pop background music track enters, featuring clean synthesizer melodies and a steady electronic drum beat. The music creates a cheerful, game-like atmosphere. (2) A sharp, high-pitched 'Ding' sound effect marks the first visual transition. A male narrator begins speaking in a high-arousal, fast-paced, and professional broadcasting tone, detailing specific game features over the continuous BGM. (3) Multiple 'Pop' and 'Whoosh' sound effects occur in rapid succession, synchronized with the appearance of game interface elements on screen. The male voice maintains high energy and clear articulation, while the BGM remains steady. (4) The female speaker returns with an excited, bubbly tone, inviting the audience to join an event. The BGM swells slightly in brightness and intensity. The audio finishes with a final upbeat musical stinger and the female voice fading out gracefully.
